propositions: The code-review gate's five LLM-calling steps (base, round_a, round_b, verify, coach) cannot express per-pass model class declarations under non-default providers when configured via a single REBAR_LLM_MODEL environment variable

Four of the five code-review steps (base, round_a, round_b, coach) inherit cfg.model implicitly rather than declaring an explicit model class, causing Pass-1 and Pass-4 to resolve incorrectly on Bedrock
Step-level model declarations on batch steps are silent no-ops because the batch path reads only from the batch sub-dict and never passes the enclosing step's model key

The runtime plumbing does not honour per-step model class declarations in the gate YAML, despite 172e landing model:standard on verify and this ticket declaring model:frontier and model:standard on other steps
